 Glow With BOJ: Beauty of Joseon Unveils Its Cult Serums at Nykaaland 2026 
 Glow With BOJ: Beauty of Joseon Unveils Its Cult Serums at Nykaaland 2026
 by Rukaiya Bohra Published on Oct 22, 2026, 18:46 IST 
 Follow On Select .co.in as Preferred on Discover Beauty of Joseon's cult serums and Korean skincare favourites at Nykaaland 2026, celebrating the brand's approach to radiant-looking skin. Beauty of Joseon brings its cult Korean skincare serums to Nykaaland 2026
 This year’s Nykaaland is bringing us the cult-favourite Korean skincare brand, Beauty of Joseon, with a fresh, new and radiant concept of “Glow with BOJ”. Globally known for their iconic sunscreen, Beauty of Joseon has much more to offer us. Their two newly launched serums will be making their debut at this year's Nykaaland. This leading Korean skincare brand brings goodness and beauty to you in a bottle, inspired by the beauty rituals of the Joseon dynasty.  
 Their bestselling sunscreen is a non-negotiable in our beauty routine, adding to the list, their two new glow serums are our two new go-tos for that radiant, smooth, Korean glass skin with minimum effort. Each serum targets commonly faced skin concerns and is designed to be gentle on the skin, making it a suitable addition to our daily skincare routine, even in humid weather. 
 GLOW SERUM : PROPOLIS + NIACINAMIDE  
 Amidst the daily grind and pollution, it's no wonder that our skin can look tired and dull after just half a day of hustle. The carefully curated formula of Glow Serum includes effective ingredients like propolis to hydrate and soothe the skin, niacinamide to keep oil and moisture levels balanced and improve the appearance of pores and BHA (0.5 %) that gently exfoliates, giving you smoother and brighter-looking skin. This thick honey-like, cushiony texture instantly absorbs into the skin without leaving any stickiness behind.
 Beauty of Joseon Glow Serum: Propolis + Niacinamide 
 GLOW DEEP SERUM : RICE + ALPHA-ARBUTIN 
 Designed to target stubborn dark spots, dull and uneven skin tone, this serum combines a years-old Joseon beauty ritual with a science-backed active, while alpha arbutin helps target dark spots and promote brighter-looking skin, rice bran water boosts moisture for glowy, dewy skin. This lightweight, quick-absorbing formula is perfect for your AM and PM routine. Fighting dullness and uneven skin tone, it works in your favour to help you achieve radiant, bright skin. 
 Beauty of Joseon Glow Deep Serum: Rice + Alpha-Arbutin 
From their iconic sunscreen to their two new glow serums, Beauty of Joseon is ready to impress us again. With the concept of “Glow with BOJ”, the brand aims to address Indian skin concerns while introducing its science-backed formulations to a new audience. Find your new favourite serum according to your skin concern and pair it with the beloved sunscreen from the brand.
